name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - § 15, après le point g - Am 81
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: (ga) Calls for the creation of a new priority and new actions within the “European Remembrance” initiative, dedicated to commemorating the crimes of communism within the Union, so that the devastation caused by this ideology is never forgotten and so that younger generations are made aware of it;
